meta.title: RFQ bid: Quote above the budget tolerance
gaps: Configure the line budget as 100 with a 10% tolerance.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure the line budget as 100 with a 10% tolerance.

steps.note: Start an RFQ event creation flow.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the RFQ line item needed for bidding.
Invite the QA vendor so the vendor portal can access the event.
Publish the RFQ for vendor bidding.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the separate vendor portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ from the vendor event list and enter its pricing sheet.

args.because: Bid price exceeds the budget tolerance limit

steps.note: Submit the above-tolerance quote and assert that the vendor portal refuses it with the required message.
